title: Apple will let EU apps use less-alarming tracking-consent screens | TechCrunch
summary: Regulators said this system, known as App Tracking Transparency, or ATT, had favored Apple over third-party apps, since Apple allows its own apps to use consumers’ data from its ecosystem without requiring a consent screen.
